description: Source code for the android SurfaceFlinger client interface, implementing methods to create surfaces, retrieve and clear layer frame stats, and mirror surfaces or displays.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Represents a client interface to SurfaceFlinger, providing methods to manage surfaces and layer stats.

methods.name: Client::initCheck
methods.description: Checks if the client is properly initialized.

methods.name: Client::createSurface
methods.description: Creates a new surface with specified parameters.

methods.name: Client::clearLayerFrameStats
methods.description: Clears frame statistics for a specified layer.

methods.name: Client::getLayerFrameStats
methods.description: Retrieves frame statistics for a specified layer.

methods.name: Client::mirrorSurface
methods.description: Creates a mirror of an existing surface.

methods.name: Client::mirrorDisplay
methods.description: Creates a mirror of an existing display.
